pipeline_stage: Stage A (Foot Detection, Chirality Classification & Keypoint Localization) - Single-Stage MVP

postprocessing_derived_keypoints.name: shin_mid
postprocessing_derived_keypoints.method: Deterministic post-processing: projected proximally along lower leg axis (throat -> achilles/heel_ground) by 1.1x - 1.2x ref_len

keypoints_architecture.production_schema: 15 Keypoints for AR Team (13 native + 2 derived in postprocessing)

channels_breakdown.0..3: Bounding box coordinates [cx, cy, w, h] in 256x256 letterbox space
channels_breakdown.6..44: 13 Keypoints [x_k, y_k, conf_k] (13 keypoints * 3 channels = 39 channels)

production_ship_target.cadence_recommendation: Execute inference every 2nd or 3rd frame (10-15 Hz) with One-Euro temporal interpolation on intermediate frames.

geometric_chirality_rule.rear_anchor: heel_back (Index 1) if visibility >= 0.20, fallback to heel_ground (Index 2) or ankle_center (0.5 * (kp8 + kp9))
geometric_chirality_rule.convention: With image Y down: cross < 0 -> left_foot (Class 0); cross > 0 -> right_foot (Class 1)

frozen_keypoints_schema_13.name: toe_ground
frozen_keypoints_schema_13.description: Ground contact directly under the big toe

frozen_keypoints_schema_13.name: heel_ground
frozen_keypoints_schema_13.description: Ground contact base of the calcaneus (plantar origin)

frozen_keypoints_schema_13.name: instep_top
frozen_keypoints_schema_13.description: Apex of the dorsal cuneiform bridge

frozen_keypoints_schema_13.name: toe_tip
frozen_keypoints_schema_13.description: Foremost tip of the toe box

frozen_keypoints_schema_13.name: throat
frozen_keypoints_schema_13.description: Anterior crease where tibia stem meets dorsal foot

frozen_keypoints_schema_13.name: achilles
frozen_keypoints_schema_13.description: Posterior insertion of Achilles tendon into calcaneus

production_expansion_15kp.ball_top: Index 5 (Derived): Midpoint of ball_medial & ball_lateral projected 0.28x towards instep_top
production_expansion_15kp.shin_mid: Index 14 (Derived): Extrapolated proximally along lower leg axis from throat, achilles and heel_ground
